author: Axiom III
title: Averaged MoE Baseline 1: Pooling-Only Expert
abstract: This is the first of two baseline experiments to support the publication of the 'Averaged MoE' architecture. This submission isolates the pooling-only expert (LSE+Mean) from the Averaged MoE, using the same DSConv backbone and post-aggregator projection layers. The result will provide a controlled comparison to quantify the synergistic benefit of the averaging technique.
